watches.name: Mono Hand - 40mm - Automatic
watches.description: Introducing the Mono Hand watch, a one-hand watch designed with minimalism in mind. This elegant timepiece features a single hand that gracefully sweeps across the dial, offering a unique and simplified approach to telling time . By emphasizing the essence of time, the Mono-hand Watch encourages you to slow down, take a moment, and truly enjoy life's precious moments. Embrace a new perspective on time with this beautifully crafted watch, where less truly is more. The case features a stunning and subtle mix of brushed and polished finishes. The dial understated design features a clean, minimalist aesthetic that highlights its amazing full lume . Painted with Super-LumiNova® BGW9 lume , the entire dial emits a refined light blue glow in the dark, ensuring both sophistication and excellent visibility in any setting. A single-hand watch ?! But how can I tell the time ? A single-hand watch features only one hand, typically the hour hand, to indicate the time. This minimalist design simplifies time-telling by dividing the dial into 12-hour segments like a classic dial, with additional sub-segments for quarters, half hours, and 5-minute intervals. The advantage of a single-hand watch is its ability to promote a more relaxed perception of time. It encourages mindfulness and fosters a sense of tranquility. Take your time, take it easy! 😌 Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷

watches.name: Kilroy - Tank Leak (10/25) - 40mm - Automatic
watches.description: 25 watches. 25 unique dials. Each one is truly one of a kind. Some limited editions are simply numbered. The Kilroy Was Here collection goes a step further: each of the 25 watches in this series is a genuinely unique piece. Every dial is handcrafted in our workshop from solid brass, through a lengthy and unpredictable artificial ageing process. Over the course of a week, different patinas and oxidation techniques gradually reveal colors, textures and contrasts that can never be recreated. Nearly half of the dials are rejected before completion, making every dial that passes our standards even more exclusive. The result is a dial that almost feels alive, with shades of turquoise, blue and bronze that shift with the light. No two watches ever look alike, and recreating an existing dial is virtually impossible. A tribute to the spirit of "Kilroy Was Here" During the Second World War, the mysterious graffiti "Kilroy Was Here" , accompanied by the iconic long-nosed character peeking over a wall, began appearing wherever American troops went. It became a symbol of camaraderie, resilience and quiet humor in the face of adversity. With this collection, Meridiano pays tribute to that remarkable resilience of the human spirit: even in the darkest moments, even amid the horrors of war, people still find the strength to smile. The engraved Kilroy figure appears on the leather strap, alongside the famous "Kilroy Was Here" inscription, as a discreet reminder of that timeless message. A dial unlike any other The unique patinated brass dial features a Pilot-style sandwich construction, offering exceptional depth with outstanding legibility. Large cut-out indexes reveal a layer of Super-LumiNova® BGW9 , providing a crisp blue glow in low light while enhancing the vintage military inspiration. Classic pilot hands The watch is fitted with Pilot-style hands , carefully proportioned for excellent legibility and also filled with Super-LumiNova® BGW9 , ensuring perfect visibility day and night. Built for everyday wear Crafted from stainless steel, the 40.5 mm case combines brushed and polished surfaces in perfect balance, offering a timeless silhouette that looks at home on virtually any wrist. A screw-down crown and screw-down caseback ensure a water resistance of 100 metres (10 ATM) , while the deeply engraved caseback is individually engraved with its unique edition number , from 1/25 to 25/25. Precision you can rely on At its heart beats the proven Seiko Instruments NH70 automatic movement , renowned for its reliability, durability and Japanese engineering. Each movement is individually hand-regulated in our workshop to achieve an accuracy of ±10 seconds per day or better, ensuring dependable performance for years to come. Handmade leather strap Every watch comes fitted with a handcrafted leather strap adorned with laser engravings of the iconic Kilroy character and the legendary "Kilroy Was Here" slogan. Like the dial itself, it gives the watch its own distinct personality while remaining faithful to the spirit of the collection. Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷

watches.name: Beyond - 34mm - Automatic
watches.description: Introducing the Beyond watch, a 34mm timepiece designed for those who appreciate elegance and mystery in perfect harmony. The dial of this captivating piece transports you to a snow-covered forest, shrouded in mist and secrets. It features sleek metallic hour markers that create a striking contrast against the enigmatic backdrop. The standout feature of the Beyond dial is its full lume design, p ainted with Super-LumiNova® BGW9 lume . As day turns to night, the entire dial glows with a mesmerizing blue light, combining timeless elegance with superb readability in any lighting condition. The watch hands , with their brushed finish , add an extra touch of elegance that perfectly enhances the overall sophistication of the timepiece. This subtle texture creates a refined play of light, giving the hands both depth and charm . In harmony with the rest of the dial, these hands elevate the watch’s character and style, making it even more distinguished and elegant. Housed in a refined 34mm case, the watch showcases a balanced mix of brushed and polished finishes , ideal for smaller wrists. With a slim profile of only 11mm and a sapphire crystal featuring anti-reflective treatment , the Beyond watch is as durable as it is stylish. Powered by the reliable NH70 movement, renowned for its Japanese quality and precision , this timepiece offers both performance and sophistication. The genuine leather strap adds a final touch of comfort, making it a pleasure to wear every day. We also offer two types of casebacks to suit your preferences: a solid caseback (the thinner option and perfect for custom engravings) and an exhibition caseback (if, like us, you love being mesmerized by the beauty and magic of automatic movements ! ). A watch for those who seek the unknown. The true question remains: What lies beyond? Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷

watches.name: The Lost Astronaut Thin - 38mm - Quartz
watches.description: "The eternal silence of these infinite spaces frightens me" (Blaise Pascal, famous French philosopher from the 17th century) But if you are brave enough, you can explore those infinite spaces with this beautiful watch and enjoy the sun rising on an unexplored exciting new world. The lumed starry sky above your head will shine through the night and let you wonder: are we really alone? Finally, the rocket-shaped second hand will add the final touch to this space-themed landscape, dancing around the dial in a frenzied race towards the edges of the galaxy! Encased in a refined 38mm case, the Lost Astronaut watch boasts a perfectly balanced mix of brushed and polished finishes, ensuring a sophisticated look that adapts to all wrist sizes. Despite its elegant presence, the case remains impressively slim at only 9.40 mm , featuring an exhibition caseback that reveals the engraved Seiko Instruments VH31 quartz movement , an uncommon and original choice that blends the charm of mechanical aesthetics with the precision of quartz. The genuine leather suede strap adds a final touch of comfort, making it as wearable as it is striking. A complimentary silicone strap is also included, offering a sportier and bolder look. A watch at a superb price point , both fun and playful , perfect for those who love unique details and celestial inspiration. Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷

watches.name: Mono Hand Mk II - 38mm - Automatic
watches.description: Introducing the Mono Hand watch, a one-hand watch designed with minimalism in mind. This elegant timepiece features a single hand that gracefully sweeps across the dial, offering a unique and simplified approach to telling time . By emphasizing the essence of time, the Mono-hand Watch encourages you to slow down, take a moment, and truly enjoy life's precious moments. Embrace a new perspective on time with this beautifully crafted watch, where less truly is more. The case features a stunning and subtle mix of brushed and polished finishes. The dial understated design features a clean, minimalist aesthetic that highlights its amazing full lume . Painted with Super-LumiNova® BGW9 lume , the entire dial emits a refined light blue glow in the dark, ensuring both sophistication and excellent visibility in any setting. A single-hand watch ?! But how can I tell the time ? A single-hand watch features only one hand, typically the hour hand, to indicate the time. This minimalist design simplifies time-telling by dividing the dial into 12-hour segments like a classic dial, with additional sub-segments for quarters, half hours, and 5-minute intervals. The advantage of a single-hand watch is its ability to promote a more relaxed perception of time. It encourages mindfulness and fosters a sense of tranquility. Take your time, take it easy! 😌 Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷

watches.name: La Playa - 38mm - Quartz
watches.description: Some watches simply tell the time. La Playa tells a story. Inspired by sunny shores and cloudless skies, its vibrant dial captures the carefree spirit of summer holidays, with a golden sun above deep blue seas and a towel resting on warm sand. This watch is a minimalist homage to summer, to leisure, and to those suspended moments when time seems to slow in the gentle warmth of sunlit days. I designed it while reminiscing about my childhood vacations in Sanary-sur-Mer, France, surrounded by my cousins. It was a simpler era, filled with sandcastles, dives into the waves, and picnics on the beach. La Playa is intentionally playful and nostalgic, a tender nod to that carefree freedom only summer can offer. Its clean, bright design is made for those who still marvel at the sound of cicadas or a sky turning pink at the end of the day. Powering the watch is a Japanese-assembled Seiko Instruments PC39 quartz movement with a true day-and-night indicator . Throughout the day, the sun slowly rises and sets over the beach before giving way to the moon at night, transforming the dial into a living landscape that brings a poetic dimension to timekeeping. The watch measures 38 mm in diameter , with a slim 9 mm profile and a comfortable 43 mm lug-to-lug , making it a perfect fit for most wrists. The dial and hands feature Swiss BGW9 lume for excellent nighttime legibility, while a flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating keeps the view crisp and scratch-free. The genuine suede leather strap offers a soft, premium feel, and for a bolder look, a free silicone strap is also included . Whether you are planning your next getaway or simply want a watch that makes you smile every time you check the time, La Playa is your sunny companion all year round. Carefully assembled by hand in our workshop in Marseille, France 🇫🇷
